faqs: Can complex diagnostics be performed remotely?
Yes, mobile mechanics arrive equipped with advanced OBD-II scanning tools capable of pinpointing complex electronic faults on-site.
How do I ensure the mechanic brings the correct parts?
You can upload a photo of your licence disc in the secure chat. This allows the professional to source the exact OEM or equivalent components for your specific model.
Does using a mobile mechanic void my warranty?
Under South African law, utilising an independent, qualified mechanic for servicing does not automatically void manufacturer warranties, provided original specification parts are used.
